title: Continuous Testing and Drift Detection — Scheduled Scans with Change Highlighting
goal: Enable scheduled weekly or daily baseline scans on saved targets, and automatically compare each new run against the previous to highlight new findings, resolved findings, and changed exposure score.
scope: Two parts: (1) SCHEDULED SCANS: activate the existing ScheduledRun model (already in DB schema). Add a Schedule section to Settings that lets the operator configure: engagement, profile (passive only for scheduled), target, frequency (daily/weekly/never), time of day, enabled toggle. Store in ScheduledRun records. Add a background job that runs on startup using APScheduler (already a dependency) that checks due scheduled runs and creates+dispatches them. Show next scheduled scan on Dashboard in the Upcoming Scans section (already present in Dashboard schema). (2) DRIFT DETECTION: after every run completion (run.status=completed or completed_with_errors), automatically compare the run against the previous completed run for the same engagement and profile using the existing comparison logic from explorer-history module. Compute: new_findings (found in this run, not in previous), resolved_findings (found in previous, not in this run), exposure_delta (current exposure score minus previous). Store as a RunDrift record (new simple table: run_id, previous_run_id, new_finding_count, resolved_finding_count, exposure_delta, computed_at). Show a Drift Summary banner in Mission Control after run completes: N new findings since last run / N resolved / Exposure score +/- N.
generation_reason: Continuous testing is the key differentiator of modern security tools (DEFION positions this as their core product). Scheduled scans and drift detection give clients ongoing security assurance instead of point-in-time snapshots.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Passive profiles only for scheduled scans. No auto-intrusive scheduled scans. Drift is informational only, does not auto-create new findings.

success_criteria: Settings shows Schedule section with engagement/profile/frequency/time/enabled fields.
Scheduled runs are created and dispatched at configured time.
Dashboard Upcoming Scans section shows next scheduled run.
After run completion, drift is computed vs previous run.
Mission Control shows Drift Summary banner after run completes.

acceptance_criteria: Scheduled scans configurable and execute. Drift computed and shown in Mission Control.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
